scope: One introductory paragraph; attribution, contribution scope and mathematical content preserved.

manuscript_changes.location: Introduction: Relation to the original analytical bounds
manuscript_changes.before: Section~6.3 of Ref.~\cite{Windt2021} already asserts that the auxiliary counts may be restricted to the matched choice, and constructs such a purification in Eq.~(192) before developing entropy upper bounds. Section~6.4 nevertheless invokes the matched choice ``as suggested by conjecture~2''. The displayed construction establishes an admissible matched-size extension; it does not provide a variational comparison with \emph{every} larger finite Gaussian extension. Here we supply that reduction and prove attainment, using the pure-factor equality condition at a fixed-total optimum. Section and equation numbers for Ref.~\cite{Windt2021} refer to the published SciPost version.
manuscript_changes.after: The matched-mode restriction is stated in Section~6.3 of Ref.~\cite{Windt2021}, which gives a canonical purification in Eq.~(192) and develops analytical entropy upper bounds. Section~6.4 refers to the matched choice ``as suggested by conjecture~2''. Building on this formulation, the present work gives an explicit variational comparison with all larger finite Gaussian extensions and proves attainment. The pure-factor equality condition at a fixed-total optimum provides the reduction step. Section and equation numbers for Ref.~\cite{Windt2021} refer to the published SciPost version.
